leadText:
The Kanto Fair host is a character of the day who appeared in The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!.

During their trip to the , , , , and came across the Kanto Fair in Virbank City, which was showcasing the treats and Pokémon that originated from the Kanto region. The host of the fair was due to show off the Kanto first partner Pokémon and began with . However, things went wrong, and Charmander was injured. With the help of Ash and , she rushed it to the local Pokémon Center, where it was quickly healed. She later apologized to the gang for any trouble she had caused, but they replied that they were just glad that Charmander was all right.
